title: ADDITIONS
officialText:
605.1 Scope. Provisions for additions shall apply where work is classified as an addition as defined
in Chapter 2.
605.2 Application. Additions to existing buildings shall comply with the provisions of Chapter 11
and, as applicable, with the provisions of Chapters 3 and 7.
